target_profile.scope: Native Apple-silicon macOS binaries, including required public and Apple-specific extensions and ABI behavior; host extensions selected by explicit capability checks.
target_profile.inventory_limits: Reviewed shared A64 forms only. This list is not a complete Apple CPU feature contract, private-extension inventory, or binary-compatibility denominator.

instruction_sources.redistribution_scope: Only factual identifiers, names, categorical/feature metadata and fixed encoding bits are included. Arm XML, authored instruction prose and pseudocode remain local and are not redistributed.

profile.description: Classic software PAuth1 VA47 with explicit key domain and two bounded clock operations. Full standard A64 reference checklist assessments; no Apple hardware signature identity.
outside_scope: all system-register/barrier operations except admitted clock forms

status_policy: Block and leaf counts are separate profile assessments of canonical forms. Nine forms overlap; counts must not be added. No Apple ISA or compatibility denominator is established.
